name: What is the warranty on a new water heater installation?

mainEntity.name: What is the warranty on a new water heater installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: New water heaters typically come with two types of warranties: one from the manufacturer covering the unit itself (tank and parts), and a separate labor warranty from the installer. Manufacturer warranties commonly range from 6 to 12 years for the tank, and 1 to 6 years for parts, depending on the brand and model. Alpha-Plumbing Services provides a warranty on our installation labor. We will clarify specific warranty details for your chosen unit during the consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: New water heaters have a manufacturer warranty (6-12 years tank, 1-6 years parts) and our separate labor warranty. Specifics depend on the unit.
